title: Research Associate Vacancy – Sociology Department Research Project
text:
ABDUL WALI KHAN UNIVERSITY MARDAN

Project Staff Required

Research Associate Vacancy – Sociology Department Research Project

Applications are invited for the following position in the research project entitled
“Social Capital and Women’s Climate Resilience: A Comparative Analysis of Women’s Adaptive Capacity in Gansu Province and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa”
, awarded to
Dr. Muhammad Bilal
, Lecturer, Department of Sociology, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan, by the
National Social Science Fund of China
.

 Position Details

S# | Position | Required Qualification & Eligibility | Duration of the Project | Remuneration
1 | Research Associate (01) | The candidate must have an MPhil/MS degree in Sociology/Anthropology/Gender Studies (with 1st division or 3.00 CGPA out of 4.00 CGPA) from an HEC-recognized institution/university and be currently enrolled in, or ready to be enrolled in, a PhD Sociology program at AWKUM. The candidate should have no third division and no more than two second divisions throughout their academic career. Preference will be given to: Individuals having experience in fieldwork, data collection and qualitative data analysis. Females with a research background/interest in women-related studies. | 18 Months | Rs: 20000/- per month (All inclusive)

✎ Terms & Conditions for Application

The above position is on a project fund basis for 18 months and will not be liable for extension after completion of the mentioned period, and there will be no financial liability on the part of AWKUM.

Only short-listed eligible candidates will be called for an interview.

The scrutiny and selection committee of the project reserves the right to accept or reject any application without assigning any reason.

Less than 3.00/4.00 CGPA will be considered second division.

Contact details, including mobile number, postal and email addresses, and all academic details must be provided with the application.

Eligibility in all aspects shall be reckoned upon the closing date of the advertisement.

How to Apply:
Application on plain paper along with CV should be submitted on or before the closing date, via email or in the office of the Principal Investigator (PI) at the Department of Sociology, Garden Campus, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan.

Important Notice:
Errors and omissions are liable to be rectified.

Application Deadline

On or before September 8, 2026

✉ Apply via Email (mailto:bilal@awkum.edu.pk)

 Visit AWKUM Website (https://awkum.edu.pk)

Application Submission Address:

Email:
bilal@awkum.edu.pk (mailto:bilal@awkum.edu.pk)

Or in person at: Office of the Principal Investigator (PI), Department of Sociology, Garden Campus, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan.

Dr. Muhammad Bilal

Principal Investigator / Lecturer

Department of Sociology

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
